A very disappointing break in the fast
Mar 2025 • Family
For a fast break on March 9, 2025: 
Tasteless dishes, seeming prepared with recycled ingredients. Even simple fries were mummified!
Strong frying smell permeating clothes and hair.
Friendly welcoming waiters.
Cold reception bordering on aggression on the part of the manager, who refuses even to accept the remarks.
Conclusion: Disappointing experience for a breakup of the young not reflecting the expected standards. It's a shame for this restaurant to serve such poor quality, in my opinion.

You should be a big eater on order to finish the starter and the meal.

Princess Salwa of Tunisia
Dec 2017 • Couples
After the Tunisian monarchs have been expropriated of all their belongings: jewelry, palaces, land, weapons, horses. The king the princes and princess found themselves becoming one of the poorest families of Tunisia overnight.
Many princes and princesses went into the service sector and worked in the restaurant and hotel business to survive and make end meet.
Salwa is one of them. She has been running this restaurant for at least three decades if not more.
During our recent visit, my husband and I were impressed by the excellence of service and the fancy antique vintage decor that retraces the complete history of the Husseinite family of Tunisia. It is a dive in the past.
I found food delicious. My husband says there are better restaurants in Tunisia.
We were the last guests of the day and we received a personal greeting from Princess Salwa. She gave each one of us kisses on the cheek.
